title: Sprint planning for the payments board
covers: decisions, owners and due dates said plainly
an owner named by someone other than the owner

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Morning everyone, this is sprint twelve planning for the payments board.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: First item is the refund export. Finance asked for it twice this month.

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: The export is mostly done. The CSV format is settled, we only need the date filter.

segments.speaker: Sam Example
segments.text: I can finish the date filter. I'll have it ready by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Great. So we agreed the refund export ships in this sprint.

segments.speaker: Riley Example
segments.text: One question. Do we keep the old PDF export or retire it?

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: Let's keep the PDF export until finance confirms nobody uses it.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Agreed, the PDF export stays for now.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Next, the retry queue. The on-call saw duplicate charges last week.

segments.speaker: Riley Example
segments.text: That was the retry worker running twice. I want to add an idempotency key to every charge request.

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: Makes sense. Riley, can you write the design note for the idempotency key by Friday?

segments.speaker: Riley Example
segments.text: Yes, I'll write it by Friday.

segments.speaker: Sam Example
segments.text: Who owns the alert for duplicate charges? I don't think anyone does.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Not decided yet. Let's come back to that.

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: Last thing, I will be out on Thursday, so code review goes to Sam that day.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Okay, that's the plan. Thanks all.

decisions.text: The refund export ships in this sprint.
The PDF export stays until finance confirms nobody uses it.
Sam does code review on Thursday while Dev is out.

actionItems.text: Finish the date filter for the refund export.
Write the design note for the idempotency key.

suggestions.agenda:
1. Refund export
2. Retry queue and duplicate charges
3. Review cover

expected.text: PAY-57 Alert on duplicate charges is open, high priority and unassigned.
Who will confirm with finance whether anyone still uses the PDF export, and by when?
